name: Solar panels and cells
summary: Photovoltaic panels and cells that turn sunlight into DC power.
uses: Charging batteries through a charge controller
Running pumps and fans directly in sun
Charging phones and radios with a small panel and a USB regulator
identify: Glass-faced panels with aluminium frames on roofs, RVs, boats, sheds, road signs, parking meters, street lights and telecom sites; small panels in garden lights and calculators. The label on the back gives Voc, Vmp and watts.
test: In full sun, open-circuit volts should be near the label’s Voc and short-circuit amps near Isc. Cracked glass and brown burn marks cut output. Strings of panels in sun make lethal DC: cover them before disconnecting.

decay.note: Lasts decades. Broken glass lets water in.
